rv.q: Melanie La Barrie also proves she can lead a cast as Old Deuteronomy who is ringleader for the only real plot you need to know.
The first half, however, needs greater energy, spectacle, individuality and visual clarity.

cn.t: Critics find this production of Cats uneven, with the iconic "Memory" standing out as an emotionally powerful highlight that elevates Lloyd Webber's musical, though the show itself receives middling marks overall.
